sourceForm.name: Name
sourceForm.connectionStringHint: Paste it from the Neon console: Connect → connection string
sourceForm.photoStoreHint: Where new photos are uploaded. Photos already uploaded stay with their own store. Keys stay on this device.
sourceForm.cloudinaryHint: Create an unsigned upload preset in your Cloudinary settings; the cloud name is on the dashboard.
sourceForm.imgbbHint: Sign in to ImgBB, open api.imgbb.com and press Get API key. Photos on ImgBB are open to anyone with the link.
